projectTitle: Odyssey (resumable Server-Sent Events for Spring Boot)
description: Odyssey (org.jwcarman.odyssey) gives Spring Boot 4 clustered, persistent, resumable Server-Sent Events: one OdysseyStream<T> handle to publish, subscribe, resume and replay typed events, on virtual threads, with storage on Redis, PostgreSQL, Hazelcast, NATS or Cassandra through Substrate.
rules: Add org.jwcarman.odyssey:odyssey plus exactly one Substrate backend module (such as org.jwcarman.substrate:substrate-redis); it auto-configures the JournalFactory Odyssey uses.
Odyssey uses virtual threads and no reactive types: do not wrap its streams in Reactor or WebFlux types.
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/odyssey/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the Odyssey version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
